get.summary:
Live events over Server-Sent Events (design 6, ADR 0018): `notification` (data: the
notification), `notifications-read`, `dashboard-changed` and `heartbeat` (no data).
Ends at the access token's expiry and at the first heartbeat whose token version check fails.

AssignableUserDto.description: A user that can be picked as an assignee: id, name and email only (no role).

AssignTaskRequest.description: HTTP body for PUT /api/tasks/{id}/assignee. A null (or missing) AssigneeId unassigns the task.

AuthResponse.description: Response of register, login and refresh. The refresh token is only in the cookie, never here.

ChangeProjectOwnerRequest.description: HTTP body for PUT /api/projects/{id}/owner. Nullable so a missing value yields a 400.

ChangeTaskStatusRequest.description: HTTP body for PUT /api/tasks/{id}/status. Nullable so a missing value yields a 400.

ChangeUserRoleRequest.description:
Body of PUT /api/users/{id}/role. Nullable and [Required] so a missing role is a 400
instead of silently becoming the enum default (Admin).

CreatedResponse.description: Body of a 201 response; the Location header points to the new resource.

CreateProjectRequest.description:
HTTP body for POST /api/projects. Fields are nullable on purpose: a missing value reaches
FluentValidation (400 with an errors map) instead of failing during JSON deserialization.
OwnerId is honoured for Admin only; it defaults to the caller.

CreateSampleRequest.description:
HTTP body for POST /api/samples. Fields are nullable on purpose: a missing
value reaches FluentValidation (400 with an errors map) instead of failing
during JSON deserialization.

CreateTaskRequest.description:
HTTP body for POST /api/projects/{projectId}/tasks. Fields are nullable on purpose: a missing
value reaches FluentValidation (400 with an errors map). A missing Priority means Medium.
Enum values travel as names ("High"); an unknown name is a 400 from model binding.

CurrentUserDto.description: The signed-in user as returned by the auth endpoints.

tasksByStatus.description: All four statuses, zero when none.

tasksByPriority.description: All four priorities, zero when none.

pendingTasks.description: ToDo plus InProgress; Cancelled is in neither group.

overdueTasks.description: Pending tasks with a due date before today.

DashboardSummaryDto.description: Dashboard numbers over the tasks and projects the caller may see.

LoginRequest.description: HTTP body for POST /api/auth/login. Nullable so a missing value reaches FluentValidation.

NotificationDto.description: A notification as the client sees it (list item and live event payload).

PagedResultOfAssignableUserDto.description: One page of a list. Returned directly in the response body (no wrapper).

PagedResultOfProjectListItemDto.description: One page of a list. Returned directly in the response body (no wrapper).

PagedResultOfSampleDto.description: One page of a list. Returned directly in the response body (no wrapper).

PagedResultOfTaskListItemDto.description: One page of a list. Returned directly in the response body (no wrapper).

PagedResultOfUserDto.description: One page of a list. Returned directly in the response body (no wrapper).

ProjectDetailsDto.description: A single project with its owner and the task counts the caller may see.

ProjectListItemDto.description:
A project as shown in the projects list. The counts include only non-deleted tasks the caller
may see: every task for an Admin or the owning Project Manager, only the caller's own assigned
tasks for a caller who sees the project through assignment.

ProjectOwnerDto.description: The owner of a project as shown in its details. Never carries credentials.

ProjectTaskCountsDto.description:
Non-deleted tasks of a project per status: every task for an Admin or the owning Project
Manager, only the caller's own assigned tasks for a caller who sees the project through assignment.

RegisterRequest.description: HTTP body for POST /api/auth/register. Nullable so a missing value reaches FluentValidation.

Role.description: Authorization role of a user. Values are persisted; do not renumber.

SampleDto.description: Read model returned by the API. Never the entity itself.

TaskAssigneeDto.description: The assignee of a task as shown in its details. Never carries credentials.

TaskDetailsDto.description: A single task with its assignee (null when unassigned) and its project.

TaskItemStatus.description: Workflow status of a task. Any status may change to any other (no transition table).

TaskListItemDto.description: A task as shown in the task lists. AssigneeName is null when the task is unassigned.

TaskProjectDto.description: The project of a task as shown in its details.

UnreadCountDto.description: Unread notifications of the caller inside the retention window (the badge number).

UpcomingTaskDto.description: A pending task due soon, with enough data for a row that links to the task.

UpdateProjectRequest.description: HTTP body for PUT /api/projects/{id}. Nullable fields, see CreateProjectRequest.

UpdateTaskRequest.description:
HTTP body for PUT /api/tasks/{id}. A full replacement: a missing Description or DueDate clears
it; a missing Priority is a 400.

UserDto.description: A user as listed for an Admin. Never carries credentials.
